name: General Goliath Upbringing

benefits.name: Gol-Kaa
benefits.description: Learn Gol-Kaa, the traditional language of many older Goliath clan communities. This learned language is not an inherited Species trait.

benefits.name: Clan Training
benefits.description: Choose one Skill training from Athletics, Insight, or Survival. Training in composite Athletics does not automatically train its independently ranked Climb, Jump, or Swim components.

benefits.name: Clan Craft
benefits.description: Choose one Competency from Cooking, Leatherworking, or Navigation, reflecting practical community traditions. The selected Competency gains proficiency but no ranks.

reviewNotes: One baseline of Goliath clan culture is selected for the first pass regardless of whether the character has Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, or Storm ancestry.
This is a learned cultural upbringing, not an inherited parent of any other Upbringing; a Goliath can explicitly select Giant Foundling or another culture.
Gol-Kaa is retained from the original 3.5e Goliath traditions. Giant remains a distinct language, which Goliaths may also learn through contact.
The exact traditions of individual Goliath clans can vary; six distinct Goliath clan cultures mapped to Giant Ancestry are not established by the reviewed sources.
No Origin feat, rune casting, ancestral supernatural ability, or mandatory Ordning membership is granted.
Gol-Kaa now has an authoritative language.gol-kaa definition under native/languages/; its learned grant remains part of this Upbringing.
